title: Reckoner button
description: Square, unhurried buttons in medium-weight 14px type: a sand fill, a hairline outline and a solid linen/merlot fill. Every one eases its background, border and text colour over half a second to the primary colour on hover.
notes: secondary: sand → merlot on light themes, 10% linen → linen on dark ones
corners follow rounded-sm (square in the reckoner theme)
